title: Chapter 512
paragraphs: Chapter 512
Episode 141. Fall (5)
Tap, tap, tap, tap, tap, tap, tap, tap...
Anne was incessantly tapping the table with her index finger. She couldn't hide her anxiety as she occasionally bit her nails.
"Damn, damn, damn...!"
Myu, sitting across from her, couldn't hide her agitation either.
For the sisters, it was no exaggeration to say that they survived in this family by relying solely on Joshua.
They never stood out at any time. Not when they were potential knights, not after they became knights, and not even now.
Especially after the defeat in the hierarchy battle against Jin, a 15-year-old intermediate student, their situation had been consistently downhill.
Chiron and Rosa never showed interest in them.
They didn't praise them when they achieved something that could be called an accomplishment, nor did they harshly scold them when they made mistakes.
Myu and Anne were just like air. They were no different from others who couldn't show an 'extraordinary' appearance as purebloods.
"Air is at least needed... huh. We're just useless, only serving as stepping stones for our outstanding siblings. Looking back, we've always been in such a situation."
"What are you talking about all of a sudden, sis? Is now the time to fall into such sentimentality? Our eldest brother is in big trouble!"
"It's not that he's in trouble; he's already finished. So we're finished too. We're no different from chickens about to have their necks wrung."
"Ha! There's no way Mother would give up on our eldest brother so easily. She must have something in mind. Something, definitely, in mind..."
Unfortunately, Myu and Anne didn't have the foresight to see what Jin had figured out.
With dark expressions, the sisters silently recalled the day long ago when Luna had slapped them.
-From what I've observed, the youngest is not a very merciful child. You two should be careful from now on.
-...Do you still have something to laugh at? Sis.
-No, I'm genuinely worried about you two. Although it feels like we've been at odds for a while, you two are my siblings too.
The youngest is not a very merciful child.
When Myu and Anne heard that from Luna, they were sure that Jin would never be able to break Joshua.
Nevertheless, they should have been more cautious. The sisters always showed more hostility towards Jin than necessary, and the results were never good, especially now at its worst.
"...Should we go beg the youngest?"
"Anne."
"Who knows? If we say we'll become his right-hand men like we did for our eldest brother, he might accept."

"We weren't his right arms. What benefits did we bring to our eldest brother? Whenever there was trouble, he had to cover for us. He took us in just because we looked pitiful. Maybe he saw himself in us, always being trampled on."
"Damn, sis, so are you saying we should just sit and wait for the day we die?"
There weren't many siblings who could take the now vacant position of the next family head. Luntia, Diphos, Mary, Jin. That was it, and the sisters thought Jin had the highest possibility.
Anyone who saw the declaration of the head would think so. And if Jin became the head, they would definitely be purged.

Even if another sibling took the throne, the result would be the same. Jin would still hold a high position due to his abilities and the legacy of the first family head, so they thought purging was unavoidable.
"...No, we need to find a new umbrella."
"That's right, sis! We can't die like this!"
"First, we need to find out why Mother abandoned our eldest brother. Maybe... it's because of our eldest sister?"
Anne's eyes widened.
"Our eldest sister?"

"Do you think Father took her on this voyage to the Black Sea for no reason? He might have tried to change her mind by showing her something there. Mother abandoned Joshua because she knew about it. It's infuriating, but our eldest sister is still the best knight."
"If she only declared her intention to become the head, she's the only one nobody could oppose. If our eldest sister takes the throne... we might survive."
Desperation sometimes leads people into a world of dull imagination. The sisters were pushing away the reality that it was impossible, and making groundless statements.

"Or, Luntia is currently searching for the first family head's legacy, right? If she achieves proper results, Mother might push Luntia instead of our eldest brother. The chances are higher for Luntia than for our eldest sister."
"In a few days, we could try visiting Mother..."
At that moment, laughter suddenly came from behind the table.
"Ahahaha..."
Swoosh!
At the same time, the sisters drew their swords and took their stances.

The place where the sisters were was Myu's room. Although they were in a state of frustration, they were still knights of Runthandel. They got chills from the fact that they didn't notice someone approaching so close.
'There was no sign at all?'
'This voice is...!'
Surprisingly, the laughter belonged to someone the sisters knew well.
"I can't stand listening anymore! Ladies, do you really think Joshua is finished?"
Playful, shining eyes, black hair, and a delicate figure.
"Ilina...?"
Ilina Runthandel.
It was surprising enough that someone had infiltrated without any sign, but the fact that it was Illyina was even more shocking.
She was Joshua's wife.
"You, when did you get there?"
"How can you be wearing the armor of a knight with such stupidity and incompetence? The Runcandel I knew wasn't like this."
Illyina had never been so rude to the sisters before.
Knights of Runcandel usually do not marry until the head of their generation is decided, and the ranking wars are over.
This was because the risk of partners and children being purged and assassinated was too high.
Also, when a new head is born, the surviving siblings typically enter into strategic marriages according to the family's command.
However, Joshua had married Illyina long ago because he had already been the next head.

Everyone thought that the reason Joshua, who was not a famous martial artist's child and had an unclear origin and no special abilities, married Illyina was simply due to impulse or temporary passion.
As if to prove it, their wedding was very modest, and their marriage was not even made public.
Illyina lived quietly like a shadow after marriage. She never got involved in the power struggles or showed any greed. Joshua also rarely visited her residence after their marriage.
So the family members thought that when Joshua became the head, Illyina would naturally disappear when he found a new spouse.
The sisters, who were looking at her now, also thought the same.
She had the position of being Joshua's wife but had no personal power at all. Yet, that insignificant Illyina was laughing at them.
It wouldn't be a problem to kill her in an instant. Since Joshua was locked in the underground dungeon, Illyina would also be destined to fall or be exiled.
But for some reason, their hands holding the swords didn't move. The sisters instinctively realized that Illyina was not the insignificant person they had thought.
Moreover, if they swung their swords now, it would be themselves who would fall, not Illyina, who had been a mere worm until yesterday.
"You... what are you?"
"What do you mean, I'm just a lady-in-waiting for you, ladies."
"I'm not asking because I don't know that!"
"Anyway, is being noisy all you're good at? The reason our orphan cherishes you ladies is precisely because of that incompetence."
Illyina slowly approached them, one step at a time.
"Step, step back."
"Get lost...!"
As Myu and Anne saw her shadow growing larger, they unconsciously stepped back.
The shadow beneath Illyina's feet was drawing something completely different from her delicate figure.
It was like a demon, a monster, or something even more horrifying. The sisters' breaths became rough as they confirmed the change in the shadow.
It felt as if an invincible darkness was pressing in on them.
In the end, the sisters couldn't swing their swords until Illyina was right in front of them. They could only tremble and sweat with fear.
"Please... save us... please..."
Begging for their lives, the knights of Runcandel seemed to have lost their souls.
They had completely surrendered just by facing her.
No matter how incompetent they were, that was only in relation to discussing Runcandel's next head.
They were also knights who had gone through numerous trials and battles until now. They had encountered many strong enemies, and each time they faced life and death.
The sisters had never been discouraged, even when facing an enemy who was clearly stronger than them.
As when Luna slapped them, when Mary beat them every time, or when they picked a fight with Jin whenever they had a chance.
However, the sisters, who had never experienced the wrath of Chiron, could not help but believe that there was no greater fear in the world than this.
Illyina looked at the sisters and smiled softly.
"There's no need to be afraid, ladies. I won't harm you."
Whooooosh...!
Illyina's huge shadow rose and began to envelop her.
Looking up at her, the sisters cried with laughter.
It was as if they had grabbed the hand of salvation offered by God in their moment of despair.
"Hahaha...!"
[I am the prophet of calamity.]
Illyina emerged from the shadow with a completely different appearance.
The darkness that should have been her body filled the spacious room, and her face, which rose like a button in the middle, was swollen and grotesque, as if it would burst at any moment.
[Take my hand, orphans.]
Myu and Anne kneeled and reached out their trembling hands toward Illyina. They felt something cold yet warm, indescribable, grasping their hands.
[I will become your parent. Say that you want it.]
"We want it..."
Then, the sisters' shadows shattered like broken glass.
One of the largest pieces was absorbed into Illyina's embrace.
[The despair you've harbored as sad orphans will make you even more valuable...]
Soon, Illyina's figure shrank again.
Underneath her feet, there was an ordinary-looking shadow as she returned to the appearance the sisters remembered. The sisters were still on their knees.
"The role of saving our orphan, Joshua, will be entrusted to you, ladies. Can you do it well?"
With a faith they had never possessed before, the sisters nodded their heads.
